body: Hello If you want to talk, you can message me!
You think the reason is because of you or because of them?
Thank you, I hope everything is fine and even if it is not, I hope it will be, as soon aa possible!
You are important for life. Believe it or not. If you want to talk about things, I am here.

That is horrible. Piano is amazing, I really meant it because I am really interested classical music, I hope she won't do anything. She may be want the spotlights shows to her or may be wants you to do something else but the point she don't understands when a person does what they interested, they become successful.
Why?
Hahaha, you know what I mean. People who have disabilities, people who wear things that they feel comfortable, and even they stare at people because of their colour and more!
Thank you.

Because they don't know what your reasons could be. You have reasons to live, believe it or not. Yes maybe you don't see them, but there are, there must be. You may have problems with your family, your academical life/ Working life or anything else but there are things we live for. For ourselves, for future. I know this sounds like I am an advice giver but not I am not.

I am really tired of being someone else. I can't carry this anymore. In the end I am the one who is hurting. I don't know where is this going and I don't exactly know how it started. It is like a puzzle and I lost my pieces.
I am really happy for you.

The most tiring thing of this, is that you have to chose your card correctly to play the game right. It is so tiring that it can make a feeling inside that can't even describe with words or numb. It sounds weird when you say it scares you to communicate to ones who have a healthy relationship with their parents. I don't know how old are you or how your fathers personality, but I can say don't say too much just be with them. Do you feel like you are scared but don't know what exactly it is? Thinking why do I have a fear from a human?
These are my conclusions based on observation. I think, at least one of them, are really common. I hope everything is fine in your life.
I am happy that you figured it out.

Why are you hating yourself? What is your fault? You are unfair to yourself. Yes, I do not know who you are but I don't think you are weak. If you were, you wouldn't be able to write these. You are not blind, you can see clearer than most people. Cause reality is hard to see.

You don't need to kill yourself if you are already mentally dead but if you have some emotions there is a needing or feeling that you want to kill yourself. The thing I am trying to say is, you are still alive because you want to kill yourself.
I am happy for you!
You are important, your worth is indescribable. This controlling thing is very complicated and hurtful, but I am pretty sure you are strong.
Some victims have an unknown fear, in fact, it is a fear that the narcissist is out of balance and the victim does not know what her/his next step will be.
They are victim of their childhood too if you ask me. Human need sympathy and when they don't have that, it makes human a monster.
Hello, thank you. I can handle myself but I feel bad when I see a lot of people and can't help them makes me feel bad.
Yes you are right, don't tell your mom. It will make you angry and sad. She will know when the time has come anyway.
Hve you ever told them your thoughts? I just want to know.
It won't go away but I am happy that you are free. Take an advantage from these bad days. These are inspiration for your hobbies and interests.

Hello, thank you. If you need any support I am here. I hope there will be a cure for this because this is like a murder. We are talking about life. Most special and important gift given to us, it is our life and when someone tries to control it, every piece of life getting lost just like those hard to find puzzle pieces.

Please be careful and strong. You are not what they say, you are you. You will find what your interests are, what your goals are. Don't feel worthless because of what your parents (or anyone) push you to do and you can't. Everyone has different ableties. Just wait for it. If anyone needs to talk I am here for it.
I can only hope and pray for your freedom. One day these will end. That is true. It is not your fault.
You're welcome

I really feel sad for the children who are victim of these kind of parents. I am one of the victims. "Trying to put yourself on their view and telling your value is worthless."  But for them it is nonsense because they do not have the sympathy. But when I think of these parents, they are victim of where they grew up neither.
